# PlayOnline chocobo pointer

`chocobo.ani`: an animated Windows cursor of the chocobo the PlayOnline Viewer used as its mouse pointer, rebuilt by a
player from screenshots of the Viewer in the mid-2000s (the original sits encrypted in the Viewer's
`viewer/data/system/image/cursor.png`). It was shared at `twpa.net/ffxi/chocobo.ani`, now gone; this copy is the
Internet Archive's (http://web.archive.org/web/20190309105903/https://twpa.net/ffxi/chocobo.ani), unchanged:
6624 bytes, SHA-256 e6ce5cc9a1ed8442a1d4b2127b33f9cbda9e57842b4367d0723eddbc99e520b4.

It came with no license, and the chocobo is Square Enix's. Like the Phoenix feather, confirm it may be shared before
this repository is public, or remove it.
